scripts.build: pnpm build:ts && pnpm build:go && pnpm build:python
scripts.test: pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:go && pnpm test:python
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:go && pnpm lint:python
scripts.lint:python: uv run --package mmdash-worker ruff check workers
scripts.format: prettier --write . && gofmt -w backend && uv run --package mmdash-worker ruff format workers
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && node scripts/check-go-format.mjs && uv run --package mmdash-worker ruff format --check workers
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm api:check
